title: mzPeak metadata.study global study-context block
description: Governs mzpeak_index.json.metadata.study. Written into FileIndex.metadata["study"] by the converter (Phase 32 SM-05) when a SDRF or ISA sample-metadata file is ingested. Carries the minimal global study context (repository accession, title, back-ref to the verbatim embedded member) plus an optional run_sample_binding provenance shadow reserved for Phase 32 (interim pre-upstream-merge binding until the list-valued ms_run.sample_ref field — Phase 30b — merges into HUPO-PSI/mzPeak). Per the lean posture (RATIFIED-G): factor_values, comment-scope, and full characteristics->Param shaping are deferred >=v0.9 — the verbatim blob anchor (Phase 31) holds full fidelity. Three-places rule: src/schema/study.rs + docs/mzpeak-imaging-spec-suggestions.md + this file.

dataset_accession.description: Repository accession for this study, e.g. "PXD011799" (PRIDE / ProteomeXchange) or "MTBLS1129" (MetaboLights). Used as the primary key for cross-referencing the embedded verbatim member against the public repository.

title.description: Human-readable study title (informative). Sourced from the SDRF Investigation Title column or the ISA investigation title field.

sample_metadata_ref.description: Archive path of the verbatim embedded sample-metadata member within the mzPeak ZIP. The back-reference that lets a reader locate the full-fidelity verbatim embed without scanning the file index. E.g. "sample_metadata/sdrf.tsv" or "sample_metadata/isa/i_investigation.txt".

run_sample_binding.description: OPTIONAL Phase-32 provenance shadow for the upstream ms_run.sample_ref binding (RATIFIED-C/F). Written only when run->sample binding is known. Omitted entirely when absent (skip_serializing_if). Will be superseded by the native list-valued ms_run.sample_ref field once Phase 30b (upstream PR) merges.

run_id.description: The run identifier, typically the ms_run id from the study-metadata file.

sample_ids.description: The list of sample identifiers this run is bound to.

binding_provenance.description: Binding provenance token. "phase32_shadow" indicates this is a provisional pre-upstream-merge shadow.
